# EngineeringXYZ

> Mechanical engineering consultancy in Irvine, California. Takes machine
> prototypes, fixtures, inspection systems, and production equipment from
> concept — or from a stalled state — to build-ready engineering.

Last updated: 2026-08-01
Canonical site: https://engineeringxyz.com
Contact: info@engineeringxyz.com · 760-515-1517
Location: Irvine, CA. Southern California on-site; remote clients nationwide.

EngineeringXYZ helps manufacturers and hardware teams move stalled machine,
fixture, inspection, and production-equipment projects toward build-ready
engineering. Every engagement is led directly by Dr. SaiKit (Marco) Wu,
Ph.D. in mechanical engineering, with specialist support coordinated when a
project requires it. Clients keep a single point of accountability.

## Services

- **Machine Prototypes and Production Equipment** — concept layouts,
  mechanical architecture, 3D CAD, engineering drawings, vendor-ready
  packages, build-readiness review, and commissioning support.
- **Fixture, Workholding, and Poka-Yoke Design** — fixture concepts,
  mistake-proofing, operator-flow improvements, tolerance and interface
  review, and fabrication drawings.
- **Inspection and Test Systems** — positioning systems, test-station
  mechanical design, part-presentation fixtures, and integration with gauges
  and optics.
- **Mechanical Design and Engineering Drawings** — 3D CAD, engineering
  drawings with GD&T as appropriate, tolerance review, design-for-assembly,
  and drawing-release support.
- **Manufacturing and Production Engineering Support** — equipment layouts,
  architecture and simplification studies, and vendor-ready build packages.
- **Project Recovery and Engineering Capacity** — design review,
  troubleshooting, overflow engineering work, vendor coordination, and
  handoff packages.

## Process

Share the current problem → review technical fit → define a focused first
scope. Most engagements start with a design review, concept package, or single
fixture. First scopes typically run two to four weeks. Confidential project
information can be reviewed under NDA.

## Verified public claims

- One machine concept was redesigned from 49 motors to 4 while retaining the
  required functions.
- 10+ years of mechanical engineering and automation experience.
- 4 U.S. patents granted and in process.
- 10+ peer-reviewed publications.

Client names and proprietary project details are withheld where required for
confidentiality. These are specific credentials and project outcomes, not
promises of typical results.

## Claim boundaries

EngineeringXYZ publishes no staff-size, office-size, revenue, or certification
claims. It is presented as a consultancy led by an experienced principal
engineer and supported by specialists when scope requires.
